regressions.evidence: Commit 6859e37 (labelled F-05) adds server.py:583-598: when `matches and not per_step`, photo mode builds claims from the transcript and calls _narrative_with_coverage -> make_narrative_llm_client() + generate_narrative, appending the LLM output to narrative_text and passing claims= into _write_all_exports. The F-05 plan said 'No server change needed' and F-01 (wire generate_narrative into _generate_photo) is held in PLAN_UNRESOLVED.md pending Brian. Net effect: for a run-on transcript with Ollama up, photo mode now ships draft/critique/revise narrative text that A-03 (also held) says is ungated against invented instructions, where before the text was placed verbatim (albeit on step 1). With Ollama down it degrades safely to [verify] blockquotes (test_photo_build_unplaced_transcript_is_kept_as_verify_claim).

regressions.title: Post-polish claim gate over-reverts step rewrites in the no-transcript capture flow
regressions.evidence: Without a transcript, claims = _narration_to_claims(_synthesize_narration_from_steps(...)), i.e. one claim per step whose text IS the step text (server.py:117). The new gate at :747-750 reverts any rewrite where `_claim_covered(c, old['text']) and not _claim_covered(c, new['text'])`; since _claim_covered is a case-insensitive substring test, every genuine rephrase of a step loses its own-text claim and is reverted. Step polish in that flow is therefore limited to case/whitespace/superset edits. Existing tests only use uppercasing stubs so they do not expose it. Low severity: polish is off by default and the failure direction is conservative (manifest text kept).
